sections.heading: Go further with the TEST ONLY Implementation Studio
sections.body: Your core programme is confirmed. The TEST ONLY Implementation Studio adds the full on-demand lesson studio, printable planners and bonus sessions, so every idea from the core programme can be revisited and applied at your own pace.

cta.text: Yes, add the Deep Work Studio to my order

sections.heading: When a lesson ends, the follow-up questions begin
sections.body: A live session moves quickly, and the questions usually arrive afterwards, when you sit down to apply the material alone and realise a key step was only covered once.

cta.text: Keep every lesson within reach - add the Studio

sections.heading: Notes scattered across notebooks slow every review
sections.body: Handwritten notes, screenshots and half-remembered timestamps make revision slow. Without a structured workbook for each lesson, reviewing what matters takes longer than the work itself.

cta.text: Get the structured workbooks - add the Studio

sections.heading: Momentum fades when replays are out of reach
sections.body: When you cannot rewatch a session, a busy week quietly becomes a missed week, and the thread of the programme is hard to pick back up without starting over.

cta.text: Protect your momentum - add the Studio

sections.heading: Why the Studio exists
sections.body: We built the Studio because the core programme was designed to be used, not just attended. On-demand access turns each live lesson into a permanent working reference you can return to whenever a real project demands it.

cta.text: Make the programme a permanent reference - add the Studio

sections.heading: Made for learners who apply as they go
sections.body: The Studio suits members who implement between sessions, who revisit material before big decisions, and who want planners that turn watching into doing. If you prefer live sessions only, your core programme remains complete without it.

cta.text: If that sounds like you, add the Studio

bullets: You implement between sessions and want the material at hand
You revisit lessons before important decisions
You learn best with a workbook open beside you

sections.heading: Exactly what the Studio adds
sections.body: The Studio adds on-demand access to the recorded lesson studio, one printable workbook per lesson, and the bonus session recordings. It does not change your core programme, your live session access, or your existing materials, which you keep in full either way.

cta.text: Add the Studio and get the full archive

bullets: Material limitation: recordings are for your own study use

sections.heading: 7 Reasons To Commit To Your Focused Future
sections.body: Seven reasons the Studio earns its place beside your core programme.

cta.text: Commit to your Focused Future - add the Studio

reasons: Your future self will thank you: every lesson stays available on the days when a real project needs that exact idea again.
Review at your own speed: pause, rewind and revisit difficult steps until the method is fully yours, not half remembered.
Planners turn watching into doing: each lesson ends with structured exercises that convert ideas into finished work.
A busy week stops being a lost week: the studio lets you catch up completely instead of returning to find gaps.
Bonus sessions deepen the core material: extra recordings explore the advanced applications the live schedule cannot fit.
One organised studio replaces scattered notes: everything lives in a single place you can search in seconds.
You already committed to the core programme: the Studio makes sure that commitment keeps paying you back for years.
